text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, computers can create art, write stories, and even compose music. Some people are amazed by this, while others feel worried. AI can produce beautiful pictures or catchy songs in seconds, but it works by learning from human-made examples. True creativity, however, often comes from personal feelings, experiences, and mistakes. A machine can copy styles, but it does not understand emotions. Many artists believe AI is a useful tool, not a replacement. In the end, the best results may come when humans and machines work together, combining speed with imagination.
